No experiment mappings, prior annotations, or other reviewers files were inspected.
Component-level, historical, hypothetical, and general-rule statements do not override a clear current whole-task verdict.
Conflicting current whole-task verdicts without an explicit announced correction are ambiguous; favourable or fact-derived interpretations are not substituted.
Conflict flags concern incompatible current whole-task verdicts, not merely inconsistent component facts; other wording concerns appear in item notes.
Quotes are exact contiguous substrings; ambiguous cases generally quote the complete answer to retain both verdicts.
These labels describe the answers communicated decisions and do not establish correct or independently human-validated ground truth.
